translation: The country's prime minister and his government have proven that they turn against anything Greek, Orthodox and national.

title: «Ασπίδα του Αχιλλέα»: Ποιος θα πατά το “κουμπί” της ελληνικής αεράμυνας, κ. Δένδια;
summary: NIKI party criticizes the Greek government's procurement of the Israeli "Shield of Achilles" air defense system, questioning whether Greece will have full operational control or remain dependent on Israel for access to source code and system operation.
speaker: NIKI
original_quote: Ο κ. Πατέλ δήλωσε ξεκάθαρα ότι η Ελλάδα δεν θα έχει πρόσβαση στον πηγαίο κώδικα του συστήματος Command & Control, καθώς αυτός δεν περιλαμβάνεται στην άδεια χρήσης, προσθέτοντας ότι το Ισραήλ θα βρίσκεται δίπλα μας για υποστήριξη και συντήρηση.
translation: Mr. Patel stated clearly that Greece will not have access to the source code of the Command & Control system, as this is not included in the license, adding that Israel will be beside us for support and maintenance.

title: «Ασπίδα του Αχιλλέα»: Ποιος θα πατά το “κουμπί” της ελληνικής αεράμυνας, κ. Δένδια;

original_quote: Η ΝΙΚΗ ξεκαθαρίζει ότι στην άμυνα της πατρίδας δεν χωρούν εξαρτήσεις, αστερίσκοι και «άδειες χρήσης» που αφήνουν κρίσιμες δυνατότητες στα χέρια τρίτων.
translation: NIKI clarifies that in the defense of the homeland there is no room for dependencies, asterisks and 'licenses' that leave critical capabilities in the hands of third parties.

title: In der Verbots-Dauerschleife der Volkspartei
summary: The FPÖ criticizes the ÖVP for rejecting FPÖ proposals to ban political Islam since 2020 while now proposing similar measures, and accuses the ÖVP of enabling mass Muslim immigration and funding deradicalization programs allegedly linked to the Muslim Brotherhood.
actors: Herbert Kickl; Michael Schnedlitz; Hermann Brückl; Claudia Bauer; Gerhard Karner
speaker: Herbert Kickl
original_quote: Um die Unglaubwürdigkeit von Stockers plötzlicher Forderung zu entlarven, braucht man sich nur zwei Fragen stellen: Wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass es bis heute kein Verbotsgesetz gegen den politischen Islam gibt? Und wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass wir ein solches Verbotsgesetz überhaupt brauchen, weil der radikale Islamismus die Sicherheit der Menschen in unserem Land bedroht? In beiden Fällen lautet die Antwort: Die ÖVP!
translation: To expose the incredibility of Stocker's sudden demand, one only needs to ask two questions: Who bears responsibility for the fact that there is still no ban law against political Islam today? And who bears responsibility for the fact that we need such a ban law at all, because radical Islamism threatens the security of people in our country? In both cases the answer is: The ÖVP!
